verdicts.reason: A: the white card runs off the top and both sides of the canvas and covers almost all of the dune scene, so the original's desert imagery is mostly lost. The See Fares CTA floats above the headline, opposite the logo, a large dead white gap separates them from the headline and the subcopy is spaced loosely. B shares the reversed order (CTA above the headline), the logo sitting next to the CTA instead of above the copy, the card running off both sides and an empty middle, but it keeps the sky band at the top and groups the headline tightly with its subcopy, so it is slightly less broken.
